{{Attr|Burn}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ghost Knight''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in the third and fourth night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event|Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had a high amount of health and an average speed. It was also a hidden and ghost enemy with defense. ==Appearance== The '''Ghost Knight''' had white neon skin and a translucent white torso. It wore dark purple shoulder-pads and chest plate. It wielded a neon white sword. Its head was slightly tilted downwards. It floated slightly above the ground. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers with hidden detection, such as the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner|{{Color|Golden}} Minigunner]], and [[Accelerator]] are recommended to defeat the '''Ghost Knight'''. *You can use the [[Ace Pilot]] to give hidden detection to towers with no hidden detection such as the [[Ranger]]. *You can use the [[Electroshocker]] to slow this down, allowing your towers to deal more damage to it. **The [[Electroshocker]] can also be used to decrease the defense of this enemy. *The [[Military Base]] is useless against it, as its units are unable to collide with the '''Ghost Knight''' or detect it. *While the [[Crook Boss]] can attack the '''Ghost Knight''' as it has hidden detection, its units cannot. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Night Four - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Ghost Knight''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **'''Ghost Knight''' added. *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **Now appears in the [[Totality Tower]]. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Ghost Knight''' removed. {{TowerOutskirts|[[Zombie Horse]] & [[Ent]]|Wave 11|Ghost Knight|Wave 12|[[Werewolf (Solar Eclipse)|Werewolf]]|Wave 13}} {{TotalityTower|[[Mega Clanker]]|Wave 11|Ghost Knight|Wave 12|[[Cursed Knight]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
